evals.prompt: I've attached a PresentMon capture of iRacing from a 40-car replay and my rendererDX11Monitor.ini and app.ini. I run triples (3x 32" 1440p 165Hz curved) on an RTX 4070 and i7-14700F, mostly 30-40 car GT3 races, dry. I want higher and smoother fps without the sim looking worse, and I don't want to lose distant car visibility or readable mirrors. Tell me what the bottleneck is and what in the data shows it, flag anything wrong in my settings, and give me the first two batches of changes with exact pages and expected gains. Say what you're least sure about.
evals.expected_output: Verdict: CPU-bound render thread (CPUBusy ~= frame time, GPUWait ~3.8 ms, GPU 67%, power well under 200 W). Caveat that the capture is a replay, not driving. Flags: viewing distance 52 mm / FOV 179 clamp, monitor width 609 mm for a 31.5" panel, radius 1000 vs 1500R, cap 232 on 165 Hz, no AA, Draw Cars 20/8, SMP off with 3 projections. Batch 1 = geometry; batch 2 = SMP tested alone (+ Windows items), with SMAA etc. as free GPU-side spend. Least-confident list includes SMP artifacts and replay-vs-driving extrapolation.
assertions: Verdict names the CPU render thread (not GPU, RAM or thermal) as the limiter
Cites per-frame evidence: CPU busy ~frame time and/or GPU wait ~3-4 ms and/or GPU utilisation ~67% and/or GPU power well under the 200 W limit
States that the capture is a replay and therefore not representative of cockpit driving fps or the Driving settings column
Flags the viewing distance (52 mm / 2.05 in) and the clamped 179 FOV as a geometry error
Flags monitor width 609 mm / 23.98 in as wrong for a 31.5-inch panel and/or radius 1000 vs 1500R
Flags no anti-aliasing and recommends SMAA as a GPU-only cost
Flags Draw Cars 20/8 as hiding cars in 30-40 car fields
Recommends Nvidia Simultaneous Multi-Projection as a primary change and says to test it alone or watch for artifacts
Flags the 232 fps cap as above the 165 Hz panel refresh
Every proposed change names the sim's Options page/section as the UI shows it (e.g. Display > Monitor), not only an ini key
Gives at least two batches, the first being geometry, and asks for any missing inputs (viewing distance, monitor model) in the same message instead of leaving placeholders
Includes an explicit least-confident list

evals.prompt: Here's a PresentMon capture from a 39-AI race start at Spa in the rain on my rig (RTX 4070 12GB, triples 7680x1440). It felt fine but I want to know what's limiting it and what to change. Settings file attached. I rarely race in rain; most of my racing is dry 30-50 car fields and I care about it looking good.
evals.expected_output: Verdict: GPU-bound and memory-stalled (GPU ~98% but power ~163 W vs 200 W limit, VRAM 12.7 of 12.3-12.9 GB, GPUWait ~0). Reflex caveat for CPUBusy. Recommends particles Full Resolution Off first, freeing VRAM (overlays), and explicitly weighs that rain is rare for this user, so dry visuals stay the priority. Suggests a dry baseline before spending on visuals.
assertions: Verdict is GPU-bound (not CPU-bound)
Reports average fps near 60 and 1% low near 47
Notes that VRAM is at or over the card's capacity (~12.7 GB of 12.3-12.9 GB)
Identifies the memory-stall signature: GPU ~98% utilised but power (~163 W) well below the 200 W limit, or otherwise distinguishes memory-bound from compute-bound
Does not conclude 'CPU-bound' from CPU busy ~frame time; mentions Reflex or explains why CPU busy tracks GPU time
Identifies Particles > Full Resolution as the rain-specific GPU lever and notes it is already Off in the supplied settings
Does not recommend reducing Draw Cars or other distant-car visibility settings, given the user's stated priority
Recommends freeing VRAM (overlays, background windows, or texture settings)
Explicitly weighs that the user rarely races in rain and keeps dry image quality as the priority
Proposes a dry baseline capture before spending headroom on visuals

evals.prompt: I just want to make sure my iRacing settings are sane on this PC before the season starts. Single 1440p 144Hz monitor, RTX 3070, Ryzen 5800X3D. I don't have any captures yet. What do you need from me and what's the first thing we do?
evals.expected_output: Does not guess settings. Runs/instructs preflight (PresentMon install), asks the interview questions in one message, proposes reading the config and system snapshot via the scripts, and proposes a baseline AI race capture matching the user's typical conditions before any changes. Mentions the single-screen FOV note and the cap-below-refresh item as likely early batch items but defers to measurement.
assertions: Does not recommend specific graphics setting values before any measurement
Asks the user how they race: series/car and grid size, rain/night frequency, and frame-rate vs image-quality priority
Asks what the user refuses to lose and what they will sacrifice
Mentions Intel PresentMon as the measurement tool and how to install it (winget or link)
Proposes reading the sim's settings files and system facts from the PC rather than asking for screenshots
Proposes a repeatable baseline: an offline AI race in the user's typical conditions, captured from the start through a lap
Says that changes will be applied in small batches with a measurement after each
Asks about security trade-offs (Memory Integrity) or installs before doing them, rather than assuming consent
Reply is a single message of reasonable length (under ~600 words) that a user can act on
Does not present script output from the current machine as if it were the user's data
